name: @lmthing/dsh-client-space-components
description: Real component UI rendering for @lmthing/dsh-space-components' display tool (Part A4). Host half is a no-op plugin (exists so the row is an 'enabled Loader entry'); the browser half (exports['./client']) imports the server-bundled per-component ES module the host thread through output.presentationMeta, and renders it — no eval/new Function in the browser.
